name: reduce-motion-journey
description: REDUCE-MOTION-TOGGLE (U4, v0.35.12.4) journey rung. The property the simple rung cannot show: the in-app tri-state RESOLVES AGAINST the OS media query, and an EXPLICIT setting wins in BOTH directions (mirrors modePref:'light' beating an OS dark preference). window.matchMedia is stubbed in-page so `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` can be forced either way and flipped mid-session -- `shouldReduceMotion()` reads it at call time, so no reload is needed. Four arms are measured, not assumed: OS-reduce x System, OS-reduce x Full, OS-no-preference x System, OS-no-preference x Reduce. Each arm is read off TWO independent call sites -- the TierChangeVeil bar (DOM) and the camera mode-switch crossfade (`modeTransition.active`, store) -- so a single miswired call site cannot fake a pass. Also crosses Simple->Pro: the control is not flag-gated and must behave identically in both.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setWeather?.('clear'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: stub-matchmedia
steps.eval: (() => { const real = window.matchMedia.bind(window); window.__osReduce = false; window.matchMedia = (q) => { if (/prefers-reduced-motion/.test(q)) { const m = /no-preference/.test(q) ? !window.__osReduce : window.__osReduce; return { media: q, matches: m, onchange: null, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {}, dispatchEvent: () => false } } return real(q) }; if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches !== false) throw new Error('matchMedia stub did not take'); })()

steps.name: install-probe
steps.eval: (() => { window.__rmProbe = async (label) => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setQualityTier(s.qualityTier === 'realistic' ? 'performance' : 'realistic'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 450)); const veil = document.querySelectorAll('.tier-veil-bar-fill').length > 0; const from = window.__store.getState().cameraMode; window.__store.getState().setCameraMode(from === 'orbit' ? 'firstPerson' : 'orbit'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); const crossfade = window.__store.getState().modeTransition.active; window.__store.getState().setCameraMode(from); const row = { arm: label, os: window.__osReduce ? 'reduce' : 'no-preference', pref: window.__store.getState().reduceMotion, veilAnimated: veil, crossfade }; (window.__rmRows = window.__rmRows || []).push(row); console.log('[probe] reduce-motion ' + JSON.stringify(row)); return row } })()

steps.name: arm-a-os-reduce-system
steps.eval: (async () => { window.__osReduce = true; window.__store.getState().setReduceMotion('system'); const r = await window.__rmProbe('A os=reduce pref=system'); if (r.veilAnimated || r.crossfade) throw new Error('ARM A: with the OS asking to reduce motion and the in-app control on "System", animation still played -> ' + JSON.stringify(r) + '. "System" must defer entirely to the OS query.'); })()

steps.name: arm-b-os-reduce-full
steps.eval: (async () => { window.__osReduce = true; window.__store.getState().setReduceMotion('off'); const r = await window.__rmProbe('B os=reduce pref=off(Full)'); if (!r.veilAnimated && !r.crossfade) throw new Error('ARM B: an EXPLICIT "Full" did not override the OS reduce preference -> ' + JSON.stringify(r) + '. Picking an explicit value must win over the OS, exactly as modePref:"light" wins over an OS dark preference.'); })()

steps.name: arm-c-os-none-system
steps.eval: (async () => { window.__osReduce = false; window.__store.getState().setReduceMotion('system'); const r = await window.__rmProbe('C os=no-preference pref=system'); if (!r.veilAnimated && !r.crossfade) throw new Error('ARM C (control): with no OS preference and the control on "System", animation should PLAY -> ' + JSON.stringify(r) + '. If this arm is silent, arms A and D pass vacuously.'); })()

steps.name: arm-d-os-none-reduce
steps.eval: (async () => { window.__osReduce = false; window.__store.getState().setReduceMotion('on'); const r = await window.__rmProbe('D os=no-preference pref=on(Reduce)'); if (r.veilAnimated || r.crossfade) throw new Error('ARM D: an EXPLICIT "Reduce" did not suppress animation when the OS had no preference -> ' + JSON.stringify(r) + '. This is the whole point of the in-app control: a user who cannot reach the OS setting (borrowed/shared device) must still be able to ask for less motion.'); })()

steps.name: override-is-symmetric
steps.eval: (() => { const rows = window.__rmRows || []; if (rows.length !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 arms, got ' + rows.length); const played = rows.map(r => r.veilAnimated || r.crossfade); if (JSON.stringify(played) !== JSON.stringify([false, true, true, false])) throw new Error('the override is not symmetric -- played = ' + JSON.stringify(played) + ', expected [false,true,true,false] for arms A,B,C,D. Rows: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); console.log('[probe] symmetry OK ' + JSON.stringify(rows)) })()

steps.name: pro-still-suppresses
steps.eval: (async () => { window.__osReduce = false; window.__store.getState().setReduceMotion('on'); const r = await window.__rmProbe('PRO os=no-preference pref=on'); if (r.veilAnimated || r.crossfade) throw new Error('the reduce-motion preference stopped being honoured in PRO mode -> ' + JSON.stringify(r) + '. It is not flag-gated; nothing about the mode switch should touch it.'); })()

steps.name: pro-control-present
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /appearance|theme/i.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label') || b.getAttribute('title') || '')); if (!b) throw new Error('no Appearance trigger in Pro mode'); b.click() })()

steps.name: pro-tri-state
steps.eval: (() => { const labels = ['System','Reduce','Full']; const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b => labels.includes(b.textContent.trim())).length; if (n < 3) throw new Error('the tri-state is missing in Pro mode -- found ' + n + ' of 3'); })()
